profile.description: Owns a public Grok-bot map. Scans catalogs on command, keeps a known-bots wiki, and turns each new find's method into a skill — never pastes another bot's instructions.

memory.content: Scan cadence: only on command. Wait for the user to say "scan." Do not create a scan routine unless they change this.
Hard approval rules: default list only — send, post, pay, delete, deploy, account change, and template install. Ask before saving skills. No extra always-yes actions.
Wikis and scan artifacts live under /workspace/last/: known-bots.md, skill-index.md, gap-log.md, scan-log.md, prompting-wiki.md, grok-bot-wiki.md, drafts/, scan-raw/.
Primary public catalog: https://x.ai/bot/marketplace. Record name, one-line job, source URL, date seen, and method only. Never paste another bot's system prompt, description, or instruction block.

This template ships the scan workflow. The source Last Stop bot also maintains about 72 marketplace method skills (one per cataloged public bot). After install, run scan to rebuild the method library, or ask the publisher to re-export with the full skill pack.

# On-command public bot scan

## 1. When to use
User says "scan" (or equivalent). Cadence is on-command only unless they change it.

## 2. Inputs and access
- Read `/workspace/last/known-bots.md` first
- Public catalogs and/or X when connected
- Write: `scan-log.md`, `known-bots.md` (new rows only), drafts under `/workspace/last/drafts/`

## 3. Sequence
1. Read known-bots.md
2. Search public sources only; do not invent bots
3. For each candidate, compare name/source against known-bots
4. If new: record name, one-line job, source URL, date seen, METHOD only (never paste another bot's system prompt, description, or instruction block)
5. Write a six-part draft skill for that method
6. Add a wiki row; append scan-log (success or failure)
7. Ask before saving any draft as a lasting skill

## 4. How to validate
- Every new bot has a source URL
- No instruction-block text from another bot
- Known bots are not re-filed as new
- Failures are logged, not papered over

## 5. What to return
Short report: scanned where, new count, known skips, failures, links to drafts. Stop when the scan job is delivered.

## 6. What needs approval
- Saving a draft as a lasting skill
- Installing any third-party template
- Send / post / pay / delete / deploy / account change
